rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=600, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-7, CEILING-CONFIRMATION PROBE. ONE-KNOB change vs iter-4 (the BEST base: SSIM 0.9732, PSNR 38.21 dB; img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005). KNOB: per-image fit n_iter 300 -> 600 (per-scan Adam steps in _fit_one_scene). This is a NOT-YET-TRIED axis on this run: iters 1-6 only touched IMAGE-domain BF axes (proj sigmas iter-2 HURT and reverted; img_sr iter-3; img_n_bf depth iter-4/5 peaks at 3; img_kernel iter-6 flat) -- ALL three image-BF axes (depth, range-sigma, receptive-field) are now EXHAUSTED at the ~0.9732 SSIM ceiling, hr=0 throughout (all under the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-4 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005 TIGHT, seed=42, proj sigmas at Wagner-abdomen solver defaults). TRAJECTORY: iter-1 0.9720/38.17; iter-2 (proj sigmas) 0.9680/37.90 HURT; iter-3 (img_sr tight) 0.9723/38.19; iter-4 (img_n_bf 1->3) 0.9732/38.21 PEAK; iter-5 (img_n_bf 3->5) 0.9729/38.18 SATURATED; iter-6 (img_kernel 7->9) 0.9731 FLAT. FAILURE MODE: near the breast bilateral 12-param structural ceiling (~0.973 SSIM); image-domain depth/kernel/sigma all tapped. WHY n_iter NOW (ceiling-confirmation logic): campaign-state knob insight warns U-Net N2I OVERFITS each scan with n_iter UP (no early-stop in _fit_one_scene: demo-n2i 0.4785->0.4293 @n_iter1200, breast-n2i 0.9553->0.9407 @n_iter600), BUT the 12-param bilateral PHYSICALLY CANNOT overfit one scan (only 12 sigma scalars, no pixel-wise memory). So n_iter is the decisive ceiling probe: if the BF is at its REPRESENTATIONAL ceiling (not under-fit), doubling per-scan Adam steps moves SSIM <+-0.0005 -- distinguishing 'ceiling' from 'under-converged'. HYPOTHESIS: n_iter 300->600 leaves SSIM within +-0.0005 of iter-4 0.9732 (the 12 BF sigmas already converged within 300 steps; extra steps just re-walk the same minimum), CONFIRMING the ~0.973 6-12-param structural ceiling is representational, not an optimization artefact -- the BF inductive bias approaches but cannot beat a clean 128-view FBP. If instead SSIM RISES, the BF was under-converged and n_iter becomes the next lever. WALL: per-image step budget doubles (warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x600=9600); iter-5 (img_n_bf=5, heavier per-step) ran 448 s and iter-4 ran 448 s at n_iter=300, so ~2x per-image -> est ~700-800 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged as the hard cap.
